verdict.rationale: The SDK provides guardrails for validating inputs/outputs, human-in-the-loop approval that pauses execution for specific tool calls (fine-grained control), and dedicated sandbox agents that run in isolated workspaces with manifest-defined files, plus a sandboxed CodeInterpreterTool. Together these give an engineering lead real levers to restrict and gate tool use and isolate execution. Missing for 10: no documented granular per-tool allow/deny permission policy system (RBAC-style), no independent/hands-on security audit or corroboration of sandbox isolation guarantees.
